title: Evidence-Guided Recovery for AI Agents with Ambiguous Tool Outcomes and Partial Execution
abstract: arXiv:2610.41453v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tool timeouts can leave AI agents facing ambiguous tool outcomes and partial execution: an action may have failed, committed or remained in flight while other workflow steps have already completed. We formulate evidence-guided task recovery over approved obligations, provider capabilities and states compatible with public evidence. A shared admissibility check handles key expiry, authorization timing, dependencies and residual effects; a terminal certificate separates actual goal satisfaction from publicly supported safe completion. The known-model implementation combines standard observation-contingent planning with a separately implemented effect-history adjudicator. In a finite study of 37 assignments, planning and three active controls each certify 28 completions; four saved synthetic fee units incur additional computation. translated_title: 面向具有模糊工具结果与部分执行的AI智能体的证据引导恢复
translated_abstract: 工具超时可能使AI智能体面临模糊的工具结果和部分执行：一个操作可能已失败、已提交或仍在进行中，而其他工作流步骤已经完成。我们在已批准的义务、提供商能力以及与公开证据兼容的状态之上，形式化了证据引导的任务恢复。一个共享的可准许性检查用于处理密钥过期、授权时机、依赖关系和残留效应；一个终止证书将实际目标达成与公开证据支持的安全完成区分开来。已知模型实现将标准的基于观察的条件规划与单独实现的效果历史裁决器相结合。在对37个任务的有限研究中，规划方法和三个主动对照组各自认证了28次完成，节省的四个合成费用单元伴随着额外的计算开销。随后，一项预注册的任务留出对比实验将规划建议与证据提示方法（含截断提示）进行了评估。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种证据引导的任务恢复框架，通过共享可准许性检查和终止证书，帮助AI智能体在工具超时导致模糊结果和部分执行时安全地区分实际目标达成与公开支持的安全完成。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an evidence-guided task recovery framework with a shared admissibility check and terminal certificates to help AI agents safely distinguish actual goal satisfaction from publicly supported safe completion when tool timeouts create ambiguous outcomes and partial execution.
